dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Ugh! That film seller's sure got a loose tongue! I told him to keep quiet...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're not planning to do anything dangerous again, are you?

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Is that the kind of person you think I am? You think that I, Charlotte, would just go recklessly barging into foreign nations just to get a scoop?

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Then you'd be right. Yes, yes I am.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: *sigh*... But even so, I still need to get the Editor-in-Chief to approve...

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: I must've pitched a dozen reasons to cover Natlan by now, it's always a no...

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Not only that, but she won't even approve any vacation! I even promised to leave my Kameras and spare film rolls behind during any personal trip to Natlan!

choices.text: But you didn't mention "Monsieur Verite" specifically...

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Hey! It's not like I lied to her. I might've just... omitted a detail or two.

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: And then, the scoundrel that sold me the film went and sold me out too!

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Euphrasie went straight to my dad and told him to ground me for a month.

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Still... Hehe, even if I can't go to Natlan, Nod-Krai's fair game! I don't need them to fund the trip either — I've got plenty of savings!

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: I've also heard my dad say he knows some correspondents stationed there... So it's a perfect place for a... vacation with news-related perks!

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: "Adventurer's Paradise"... "Elysium"... Its reputation alone is worth writing a few pieces about!

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Okay! I'm off to buy some supplies. I'll need some warm clothes, and a whole lot of spare film and equipment...

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Right... And I need to convince Mom and Pops, too, so they can contact their friends over there. Otherwise, I'll need to find lodging on my own...

choices.text: And you can buy film on the way there...
